title: Concept: Source commit reference in a response
description: A commit hash paired with a branch name in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The pair names the exact source revision serving traffic, which lets an attacker read that revision for vulnerabilities if the repository is public or leaked.
applicability: Deployments that render a commit hash paired with a branch name into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The pair names the exact source revision serving traffic, which lets an attacker read that revision for vulnerabilities if the repository is public or leaked.
